lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Round 2 reviewer finding at test/init.test.ts:74 (SECTION 5b of scripts/cam/review-artifact.txt): US-R1-003's name-only directory-listing snapshot (snapshotDir returning [...readdirSync(dir)].sort()) could not detect a regression that OVERWRITES the pre-existing ~/.config/cam/config.toml at the exact default path, because the listing is identical before and after (reproduced by the reviewer: before=["config.toml"], after=["config.toml"] => MISSED). This machine has exactly that stale file, so the guard's own header-comment claim ('goes red the moment any future code path writes a new file... including at the exact default path') was false on this repo's dev machine. Took the reviewer-identified stronger fix (patterns.md 'homedir() env-mutation' bullet option (a), not the cheaper stat/mtime mechanical alternative, per the no-shortcuts-on-effort-grounds instruction): test/init.test.ts now spawns a genuinely separate `bun` child process (Bun.spawnSync) with `HOME` set in the spawn-time env, pointed at a freshly mkdtempSync'd empty temp dir. That directory is guaranteed to have no `.config/cam` before OR after a non-regressing runInit(), on every machine (dev box or CI runner alike) -- so the assertion is a FIXED `null`/`null`, not a same-as-before diff, and it cannot be blind to an overwrite-at-default-path regression the way the name-only same-machine snapshot was. New fixture file test/fixtures/init-home-redirect-probe.ts contains the actual runInit()-driving logic (imported and run inside the child process, so it observes homedir() as resolved by the redirected HOME) and prints `{before, after}` as its last stdout line, which the parent test parses (skipping runInit's own linear print output ahead of it). Verified the guard is now genuinely falsifiable by hand-simulating the exact regression this story is about (temporarily adding a config.toml write inside runInitLinear, confirming the test goes red with `after: ["config.toml"]`, then reverting via git checkout -- src/commands/init.ts) BEFORE trusting it green. No production src/ files touched; scope was strictly test/init.test.ts + the new fixture, per the finding. All quality gates green: typecheck 0 errors, full `bun test` 5760/5760 pass, full `bun run check:all` spine (coverage/dead-code/dup/lint/file-size/ci-parity/skip-ratchet/agents-md) all ok.
